historical_role: Pre-designated supplementary cross-domain ICU/OR/Cath-lab evaluation cohort (screened on metadata/.ari in EXTERNAL_TARGET_SCREENING_20261122.md prior to Wave-1/Wave-2; ZERO .dat waveforms downloaded and ZERO model predictions run prior to sealing this registry & contract).
annotation_caveat: PhysioNet .ari annotations were prepared via an assisted workflow (Marquette/Aristotle) with manual care but are explicitly noted by PhysioNet as 'likely to contain a small number of errors'; agreement with .ari constitutes an inherent ceiling for rare Class-F evaluation.
identity_caveat: MGHDB originates from Massachusetts General Hospital (distinct hospital from BIH/INCART/EDB/LTSTDB), but lacks an official cross-database patient ID linkage; absence of documented overlap is not absolute proof of zero cross-database patient overlap. Within MGHDB, Tier-1 merges 7 explicitly cross-referenced multi-record patients from patient-guide.shtml; Tier-2 additionally merges 11 suspected duplicate clinical groups for conservative sensitivity bootstrap.

eligibility_rules_locked_pre_waveform.channel_selection_rule: First two valid ECG channels in .hea order (excluding 'No ECG', 'No signal', and hemodynamic channels).
eligibility_rules_locked_pre_waveform.paced_exclusion_rule: Exclude records with count('/') + count('f') > 10 (AAMI non-paced criterion).

patient_grouping_rules.aggregation_rule: For multi-record subjects, sum TP, FP_NS, FP_V, tot_F, s2_F, and evaluated post-prefix hours across all eligible recordings of that subject BEFORE computing subject-level Recall and FAPH.
